Name: Pickpocket
AI_Visual_Description: A lanky hunched figure in tattered soot-stained tunics. Features sharp rat-like facial expressions with oversized nimble fingers and a notched bronze dagger. 2D hand-drawn style with cinematic rim lighting.

Name: Training_Dummy
AI_Visual_Description: A sturdy burlap-and-straw manikin mounted on a heavy spring base. Patched with leather and studded with broken practice arrows. Vibrant cartoon textures with visible stitching.

Name: Giant_Rat
AI_Visual_Description: A hulking rodent with patchy bristly fur and a scarred snout. One milky white eye and elongated yellowed incisors dripping with viscous foam. Realistic fur rendering in a 2D plane.

Name: Drunk_Patron
AI_Visual_Description: A burly red-faced man in a stained waistcoat swinging a heavy pewter mug. Unsteady stance with exaggerated swaying physics and messy expressive linework.

Name: Alley_Ruffian
AI_Visual_Description: A broad-shouldered thug with a flat nose and heavy brow. Wearing a hood that casts deep shadows over the face; wielding a jagged dirk. Gritty comic-book shading.

Name: Cat_Thief
AI_Visual_Description: A lithe silhouette in dark indigo leather armor. Large expressive yellow eyes peeking through a cowl; carrying a coil of silken rope. Fluid animation-ready silhouette.

Name: Corrupt_Clerk
AI_Visual_Description: A spindly man with an oversized collar and ink-stained fingers. Uses a heavy iron-bound ledger as a shield; frantic and paranoid facial expressions.

Name: Feral_Cat
AI_Visual_Description: A mangy tomcat with a notched ear and a permanent snarl. Arching back with fur standing on end; claws are drawn with sharp dangerous highlights.

Name: Animated_Armor
AI_Visual_Description: A hollow suit of dented plate mail held together by ethereal blue light. The visor glow is the only focal point; heavy metal textures with realistic scratches.

Name: Town_Bully
AI_Visual_Description: A chubby aggressive youth with a gap-toothed grin and a sleeveless vest. Large heavy fists and a swaggering posture. Exaggerated suburban-fantasy aesthetic.

Name: Skeletal_Sentry
AI_Visual_Description: A bleached-white skeleton wearing a rusted half-helm. Green spectral flames flicker in the ribcage; holding a spear with a moss-covered shaft.

Name: Giant_Bee
AI_Visual_Description: An oversized fuzzy bee with iridescent wings and a menacing barbed stinger. Exaggerated compound eyes reflecting the forest canopy; vibrant yellow and black contrast.

Name: Cultist
AI_Visual_Description: A figure in deep crimson robes embroidered with golden eyes. Face hidden by a wooden bird mask; clutching a glowing violet scroll.

Name: Shadow_Wraith
AI_Visual_Description: A wispy amorphous cloud of smoke with elongated claw-like hands. Two pin-prick white eyes are the only solid features; edges blur into the background.

Name: Corrupted_Dryad
AI_Visual_Description: A humanoid figure made of gnarled blackened wood and wilted autumn leaves. Glowing purple veins pulse through the bark; tragic but menacing expression.

Name: Briar_Beast
AI_Visual_Description: A quadrupedal predator made of interwoven thorny vines. A singular glowing core acting as a heart; sharp wooden fangs and a bramble tail.

Name: Feral_Hound
AI_Visual_Description: A wolf-like creature with elongated limbs and glowing red eyes. Saliva dripping from a maw full of realistic needle-teeth; sleek dark fur.

Name: Spore_Servant
AI_Visual_Description: A fungal-infected zombie with large glowing mushrooms sprouting from its shoulders. A vacant stare and a trail of colorful toxic spores following its movement.

Name: River_Lurker
AI_Visual_Description: A reptilian humanoid with slick teal scales and webbed hands. Large bulbous eyes on the sides of the head; wearing necklaces made of river stones.

Name: Brood_Mother
AI_Visual_Description: A massive spider with a bloated abdomen covered in tiny unhatched eggs. Multiple glowing eyes and dripping fangs; dark velvet textures.

Name: Ice_Golem
AI_Visual_Description: A massive construct of jagged translucent blue ice. Internal fractures catch the light; heavy blocky limbs and a frozen breath effect.

Name: Yeti
AI_Visual_Description: A mountain of white fur with massive blue horns and a protruding underbite. Large paws with black claws; breath creates a persistent mist.

Name: Frost_Wisp
AI_Visual_Description: A small floating orb of concentrated blizzard energy. Jagged ice crystals orbit the center; leaves a trail of frost on the UI.

Name: Tomb_Wight
AI_Visual_Description: A withered corpse in frozen rags. Skin is blue and mummified; holding a rusted ancient blade with ice-slicked edges.

Name: Frost_Mimic
AI_Visual_Description: A treasure chest with a jagged ice lid that opens to reveal a purple tongue and rows of diamond-sharp teeth. Icy drool hangs from the rim.

Name: Ice_Bat
AI_Visual_Description: A bat with wings made of thin sheets of ice. Transparent body revealing frozen organs; emits a high-pitched crystalline screech.

Name: Snow_Stalker
AI_Visual_Description: A sleek panther-like beast with white fur and glowing blue stripes. Moves with a low-to-the-ground slinking animation; silent footsteps.

Name: Freezing_Elemental
AI_Visual_Description: A swirling vortex of slush and freezing water. Suspended ice chunks act as fists; core is a bright glowing sapphire.

Name: Ghost_Scholar
AI_Visual_Description: A translucent blue ghost in tattered academic robes. Clutching a glowing tome; face is a mask of eternal studious concentration.

Name: Kobold_Miner
AI_Visual_Description: A small lizard-man in a heavy parka and a candle-lit helmet. Gripping a pickaxe twice his size; soot-stained snout and tail.

Name: Giant_Scorpion
AI_Visual_Description: A massive arachnid with a sandy chitinous shell. Stinger glows with a neon-green toxin; realistic desert weathering on the carapace.

Name: Sand_Spirit
AI_Visual_Description: A humanoid torso emerging from a sand-devil. Face is a hollow porcelain mask; hands are made of swirling golden dust.

Name: Desert_Soldier
AI_Visual_Description: A skeleton in ancient sun-bleached bronze armor. Wearing a tattered kaffiyeh; holding a curved scimitar with a notched edge.

Name: Fire_Imp
AI_Visual_Description: A small winged demon with skin like cooling lava. Carrying a round black bomb with a sputtering fuse; manic wide-eyed expression.

Name: Mummy_King
AI_Visual_Description: A tall figure wrapped in fine linen and gold chains. Wearing a heavy jewel-encrusted pharaoh's mask; slow regal movements.

Name: Dust_Devil
AI_Visual_Description: A whirling cyclone of grit and debris. Sharp rocks and glass shards spin within the funnel; two glowing orange eyes in the center.

Name: Scarab_Swarm
AI_Visual_Description: A literal carpet of iridescent green and gold beetles. Chitinous clicking sounds and shimmering metallic reflections.

Name: Desert_Ghoul
AI_Visual_Description: A gaunt gray-skinned humanoid with elongated limbs and a protruding tongue. Crouched in a predatory pounce; wearing scraps of nomad cloth.

Name: Salt_Golem
AI_Visual_Description: A blocky giant made of white crystalline salt cubes. Rubbing sound of stone on stone; sharp geometric edges and glowing amber eyes.

Name: Shard_Beast
AI_Visual_Description: A wolf-shaped construct made entirely of obsidian and glass shards. Highly reflective surface that catches the desert sun.

Name: Mud_Walker
AI_Visual_Description: A dripping mass of sludge and peat in a vaguely humanoid shape. Mossy branches for arms and a single sunken glowing eye.

Name: Bog_Horror
AI_Visual_Description: A terrifying mix of elk and alligator parts covered in hanging swamp moss. Massive antlers and a toothy maw; dark muddy palette.

Name: Willow_Wisp
AI_Visual_Description: A flickering greenish-blue orb of light. Core contains a tiny screaming face; leaves a trail of swamp gas.

Name: Giant_Crocodile
AI_Visual_Description: A massive ancient croc with wooden-looking scales. Covered in lily pads and swamp weeds; yellow slit eyes.

Name: Mist_Stalker
AI_Visual_Description: A translucent entity that looks like swirling gray fog. Elongated fingers and a featureless face; nearly invisible against the background.

Name: Leech_Swarm
AI_Visual_Description: A cluster of fat pulsing black slugs with circular tooth-lined maws. Slime-slicked textures and wet sound effects.

Name: Drowned_Sailor
AI_Visual_Description: A soggy undead sailor with a bloated gray face and seaweed in his hair. Dragging a heavy rusted anchor.

Name: Vine_Strangler
AI_Visual_Description: A mass of sentient thick green vines with thorns. Central flower mouth that snaps at the player; wet leaf textures.

Name: Ooze_Cube
AI_Visual_Description: A transparent lime-green cube of jelly. Floating skeletal remains and half-dissolved items are visible inside.

Name: Blood_Flyer
AI_Visual_Description: A giant mosquito with a pulsing red abdomen and needle-sharp legs. Veiny translucent wings and a twitching proboscis.

Name: Deep_Lurker
AI_Visual_Description: A massive angler-fish-humanoid hybrid with thick leathery skin. A glowing lure dangles from its forehead; rows of translucent teeth.

Name: Glow_Eel
AI_Visual_Description: A long serpentine eel with neon-cyan stripes that pulse with electricity. Fins look like tattered silk; dark deep-sea blue skin.

Name: Drowned_Captain
AI_Visual_Description: An undead officer in a heavy brass diving suit. Barnacles cover the metal; the glass visor is cracked, revealing a skeletal grin.

Name: Bone_Picker
AI_Visual_Description: A small hunched creature with a massive backpack of scavenged whale bones. Wearing a mask made of a shark skull.

Name: Heat_Crab
AI_Visual_Description: A crab with a shell that looks like cooling volcanic rock. Steam vents on its back and pincers that glow orange-hot.

Name: Void_Ray
AI_Visual_Description: A manta-ray shape made of starry nebula gas. Fins ripple with space-like energy; no eyes, just a pulsing core.

Name: Angler_Fiend
AI_Visual_Description: A terrifying deep-sea predator with elongated spindly limbs. Multiple glowing lures and a jaw that unhinges 180 degrees.

Name: Shock_Jelly
AI_Visual_Description: A massive jellyfish with long stinging tentacles that crackle with white lightning. Transparent body showing a glowing brain.

Name: Merrow_King
AI_Visual_Description: A majestic but decaying merman with a crown of black coral. Skin is translucent and pale; holding a heavy obsidian trident.

Name: Current_Wraith
AI_Visual_Description: A ghost made entirely of bubbles and swirling dark water. Wields the crushing pressure of the deep like a weapon.

Name: Void_Stalker
AI_Visual_Description: A tall slender entity with skin like the night sky. Featureless face with three vertical glowing slits; glitched reality effects.

Name: Brain_Eater
AI_Visual_Description: An octopus-like creature with a massive exposed glowing brain. Tentacles end in surgical needles; floats with a pulsing aura.

Name: Vampire_Lord
AI_Visual_Description: A regal figure in black silk and armor. Skin is marble-white; eyes are pits of pure void; cape turns into shadows.

Name: Forge_Automaton
AI_Visual_Description: A heavy mechanical guardian made of black obsidian. Glowing violet joints and a massive hammer for a hand.

Name: The_Keeper
AI_Visual_Description: A titan-sized entity in gold and white robes. Face is a giant floating golden keyhole; hands are made of constellation lines.

Name: Gravity_Well
AI_Visual_Description: A floating black hole surrounded by orbiting debris. Screen distorts slightly when it moves; deep bass sound effects.

Name: Echo_Shade
AI_Visual_Description: A mirrored copy of the player character but in monochrome gray. Movements are slightly delayed; face is a cracked mirror.

Name: Glitch_Horror
AI_Visual_Description: An entity that shifts between 2D and 3D shapes. Covered in digital artifacts and flickering scanlines; high-pitched static sounds.

Name: Rift_Walker
AI_Visual_Description: A creature with multiple sets of legs and no torso. Walks through floating rifts; body is made of purple crystalline shards.

Name: Silent_One
AI_Visual_Description: A monk in heavy leaden armor with his mouth sewn shut. Carries a massive bell that emits silence instead of sound.

Name: Lava_Slug
AI_Visual_Description: A massive slug of molten orange rock. Leaves a trail of fire; body pulses with heat waves and air distortion.

Name: Steam_Mephit
AI_Visual_Description: A small imp made of pressurized steam. Hissing sounds and white vapor trails; face is a brass pressure gauge.

Name: Core_Guardian
AI_Visual_Description: A colossal knight made of white-hot iron. Every step creates a localized tremor; holding a massive molten shield.

Name: Fire_Bat
AI_Visual_Description: A bat with wings made of solar flares. Body is a charred skeleton; leaves a shower of sparks when it flies.

Name: Sulfur_Spirit
AI_Visual_Description: A yellowish-green cloud of toxic gas with two angry glowing eyes. Face is permanently twisted in a choking expression.

Name: Smelter_Demon
AI_Visual_Description: A demonic titan with a furnace for a chest. Molten metal leaks from its mouth; horns are made of cooling black rock.

Name: Diamond_Spider
AI_Visual_Description: A spider with a body made of a single massive diamond. Sharp prismatic reflections; legs are needles of reinforced steel.

Name: Ash_Wraith
AI_Visual_Description: A spirit made of falling ash and embers. Shape is constantly shifting; eyes are the color of cooling coals.

Name: Core_Scout
AI_Visual_Description: A small spherical drone with a single large red lens. Brass casing with spinning gears and steam vents.

Name: Cinder_Cat
AI_Visual_Description: A large cat made of black charcoal with veins of fire. Fur is made of rising smoke; tail is a whip of flame.
